news.title: Butler University Receives $5 Million Grant From Allen Whitehill Clowes Charitable Foundation to Further Advance Midtown Arts District Vision
news.summary_en: Butler University’s Midtown Arts District has received an additional $5 million grant from the Allen Whitehill Clowes Charitable Foundation (AWCCF) to further support renovations to Clowes Memorial Hall and construction of the Whitehill Ballroom, the University’s newest performance venue scheduled to open in December 2027.
